notes: Back-banner Red Bull replacement on the dark navy panel. Tighter mask_dilate=4 (vs P3-A5's 8) means the inpaint footprint is closer to the original Kia letterforms; this slightly raises the risk of a residual ghost rather than a clean overpaint. Looking carefully across early/mid/late strips I can see a faint rectangular brightness boundary around the Red Bull region — most visible on darker frames where the surrounding banner blends with the crowd. Letters and bull rings are crisp and well-shaped; no obvious edge reflex or smearing on the wordmark. Color sits half a stop bluer than the surrounding panel but reads as legitimate banner print. Edge seam is marginally more visible than P3-A5; halo_presence drops from 5 to 4 due to the residual outline. Overall the back banner is slightly worse than P3-A5 — the dilate cut is too aggressive for this surface.
